**Refining report language**

I'm looking to combine some phrases to make the report clearer. I think starting with "The report provides an insightful overview of the findings and describes the sample" keeps it natural. The sample includes 80 responses from one department, which isn’t representative of the whole company. While I’m repeating "overview," the way I've combined it feels okay. I wonder if stating, "It also provides an overview of the sample" comes off as a bit mechanical, though. It's all about preserving the intended meaning!
